field_guide.mapping: Defines all element types (terrain and interactive objects), where the key is a single-character representation of the element.
field_guide.terrain: Single-tile terrain layer. Each character in each row string of the grid array directly corresponds to a key in mapping
field_guide.interaction: Multi-tile interactive object layer. The anchor represents the top-left corner coordinate of the area occupied by the object, and the object extends size-specified tiles to the right (+x) and downward (+y) from that point. Includes: id (unique identifier), category (category), element (references mapping key), anchor (top-left corner coordinates {x,y}), size (occupied tiles {width,height})
field_guide.collision: Collision type for physics behavior. prevent: no collision detection or events; Passive: triggers collision events only, no physical response; Active: full collision with movement response; Fixed: immovable solid object that blocks Active bodies

X.name: space
X.description: empty area, all entities can pass through freely, no collision detection, used for open flight space

#.name: indestructible_wall
#.description: solid terrain (rocks, organic walls, biomechanical structures), blocks player/enemy/projectile permanently, causes instant death on player contact, cannot be destroyed

D.name: destructible_wall
D.description: breakable obstacle (ground targets, bubbles, cell membranes), blocks player/enemy movement, can be destroyed by player projectile

H.name: hazard
H.description: environmental trap (volcanoes, tentacles, fire jets, solar prominences), damages or instantly kills player on contact, may emit periodic projectiles or flames, some hazards move in fixed patterns

T.name: turret
T.description: stationary enemy gun emplacement, blocks player movement, fires projectiles at player direction periodically, can be destroyed by player projectile

P.name: player
P.description: player spacecraft, moves in all directions, fires missiles, destroyed on contact with walls/enemies/hazards/enemy projectiles

E.name: enemy
E.description: spawn point for enemy waves (normal/elite/formation), enemies fly in preset patterns or chase player, destroyed by player projectile, damages player on contact

B.name: boss
B.description: spawn point for stage boss (giant brain, dragon, moai heads, etc.), large enemy with multiple attack patterns, has destructible core that must be hit to defeat, spawns minions during battle, blocks screen scrolling until defeated
